<div class="review-text">
An interesting and powerful spiritual successor (and competitor!) to <a href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/651150/Quantum_League/">Quantum League</a>. What it lacks in polish, aesthetic quality, and fluidity of movement and game-play, it makes up for in core design principles. So while I'll always be a bit sore that the beautiful execution of Quantum League was left in the dust, Lemnis Gate seems to promise much more in terms of strategic depth and simple robustness as a game to become deeply engaged in.
</div>
